name: Self Maximizer
description: Capture chats, emails, and texts from any page and send them to Self Maximizer for AI sorting into personal and work memories.
_comment_permissions: activeTab only: the extension can read a page ONLY when you click the toolbar button or use its context-menu item. It has no standing access to your browsing. host_permissions is limited to the Self Maximizer app itself so captured text can be handed to your dashboard tab.
